## Change and handoff

Name the stage or shared document. If a file interface changes, identify its producer and consumers, link the contract change, and give one example that distinguishes the old and new behaviour.

## Verification

Give the commands and results. For a real-case run, name the official CDS profile or verified snapshot ID and the downstream handoff checked. If the data were unavailable, record the outstanding check. Routine CI checks syntax, CLI help and the pilot request plan.

For a map change, give the grid extent and spacing, plotted variable, units and unknown-cell treatment. For a public interface change, check that its English docstring describes the inputs, outputs and rejection conditions that the tests exercise.

- [ ] Reviewed the outgoing commits, identities, files and notebook metadata before pushing, using the public repository checklist in `AGENTS.md`.
- [ ] Kept CDS credentials, private links, downloaded data and executed notebooks outside the commit.
